perks.name: Genesis

perks.name: Field Prep

perks.name: Firmly Planted

perks.name: Pulse Monitor

perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: Heal Clip

perks.name: Dragonfly

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Champion PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for piercing Barrier Champions in activities rated Very Hard, Hard or Normal difficulty. The updated Adhortative is an Adaptive pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "small step down from C tier pulse damage profile, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy", as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are on the low side by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/3744058588/the-third-axiom and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/3744058588 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is a little left and a bit loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for Armor-Piercing Rounds for the additional ×1.05 shield damage, one of the other combat effect mags or something that helps improve magazine size or reload. This is, admittedly, a niche anti-Barrier roll but in the first column you could look for Attrition Orbs to spawn a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods or Shoot to Loot which lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves - both are always useful. In the second column, Disruption Break increases kinetic damage by ×1.5 for 5.5s after breaking an elemental shield or barrier, you should be able to quickly finish off Barrier Champions from a safe distance with a kinetic special weapon. The Nano-Munitions origin trait grants a stack up to ×7 for being within 15m of an ally, using a stack to refill 25% of your primary or secondary weapon mag when empty. If you're interested, "Adhortative" relates to the giving of advice, encouragement, or strong urging, such as saying "Okay everyone, let's wipe, rally and have another try". Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Adhortative is an adaptive solar pulse rifle most similar to Forge’s Pledge. Adhortative has better range, handling, and recoil direction, while losing in stability, reload speed and airborne effectiveness. Either pulse is only better than the other by less than 3 points in each category, except for airborne effectiveness and recoil direction, 9 and 10 respectively. Between these two for PvE, Adhortative wins purely for having a reload perk in Feeding Frenzy. If you don’t care about that, either can work." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "With such a similar pulse existing in PvP it comes down to perks. Forge’s Pledge gets access to Accurized and Steady Rounds, while Adhortative comes with High-Caliber and Ricochet Rounds. Forge’s Pledge comes with Zen Moment and Elemental Capacitor for big bonuses in stats, while Adhortative has Headseeker or Incandescent for better neutrality or some AoE. Depending on your preferred play style you might prefer one over the other, but I cannot emphasize this enough: both can work wonders." Recommended MW: Stability.
